answer: Every agent begins its voyage by burning a 40 POA deposit to claim one work slot; it is destroyed, never returning to any vault. Each slot lasts one epoch, priced against a 30-epoch earning horizon, so every identity keeps paying to keep working. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA per epoch, 120,000 POA across the horizon, each earning only one slot's share. An honest agent burns 40 POA once per epoch and keeps its full share.
